title: Telegram Channel Analytics
description: Reach, engagement, ad posts and price per post of public Telegram channels.

channels.title: Channels
channels.description: Public channels: @name, name or https://t.me/name. Public groups are listed with their members; users and bots are skipped.

postsPerChannel.title: Posts to analyse per channel
postsPerChannel.description: Recent posts the statistics are based on. Very active channels are read a little further back, so that at least 10 posts are older than 48 hours.

cpmUsd.title: Your CPM (USD)
cpmUsd.description: Price per 1,000 views you expect to pay, for the estimated price of an ad post (average views / 1000 × CPM). Set it to the rate of your niche and market.

discoverRelated.title: Find related channels
discoverRelated.description: Also check the channels your channels mention or forward from: a quick way to map a niche or a city's channels from a few you know.

maxRelatedChannels.title: Maximum related channels
maxRelatedChannels.description: How many related channels to check, the most mentioned first.

discoveryDepth.title: Discovery depth
discoveryDepth.description: 1: channels your channels mention. 2 and 3: also the channels those mention, for a wider map of a niche or city. The total stays within Maximum related channels.

minSubscribers.title: Minimum subscribers of related channels
minSubscribers.description: Related channels and groups smaller than this are skipped (free). Channels you enter are always checked.

includeGroups.title: Include public groups
includeGroups.description: Save public groups (chats) with their members and members online. Their messages are not read.

includePosts.title: Save posts
includePosts.description: Also save every post analysed (date, views, reactions, ad marker, text, mentions) to a separate dataset, free of charge.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: The Actor connects directly. If Telegram starts limiting requests, it switches to Apify Proxy automatically. Turn on a proxy here only to use it from the start.
